presentation.title: Hammer Jam (Test)
presentation.summary: Our remote event test is active: 50% shorter eligible Home Village upgrades and 50% lower wall costs, combined with Gold Pass. These are test dates and tracker adjustments, not a live in-game announcement.

sections.title: Test event — not an official announcement
sections.body: This event is enabled to test Clashboard’s remote news, countdowns, detail pages, wall discounts, and upgrade adjustments. The October 6–20 dates are test dates, not announced Clash of Clans event dates. This configuration changes the tracker only; it cannot activate a boost in the game.

sections.title: 50% shorter upgrade times
sections.body: This test uses a 0.5 time multiplier for eligible Home Village builder, Laboratory, and Pet House upgrades at every Town Hall level. Builder Base and Star Laboratory upgrades are outside this test. Actual event rules must be confirmed before a real announcement.

sections.title: 50% lower upgrade costs
sections.body: The recent Hammer Jam format reduced eligible upgrade resource costs by half, including walls. In this Clashboard test, wall costs show the 50% discount; other upgrade cost displays are not modified by this event engine.

sections.title: Gold Pass works alongside the event
sections.body: Gold Pass and the event multiply. A 20% Gold Pass discount combined with the 50% event factor leaves 40% of the base amount—a total reduction of 60%. For example, a 10-day duration becomes 4 days, and a 4,000,000 wall cost becomes 1,600,000.

sections.title: What happens to upgrades already running?
sections.body: For eligible timers tracked before the test begins, Clashboard caps the remaining duration at the event-adjusted full upgrade duration, calculated at the event’s start time. Shorter remaining timers stay unchanged. Opening the app later uses that original boundary, so elapsed time is not reset. Importing fresh Clash data during the event preserves the exported remaining times without applying the discount again.

sections.title: Supercharges and Crafted Defenses
sections.body: Supercell’s November 2025 Hammer Jam excluded Supercharges and Crafted Defenses. This test follows those exclusions. Hero equipment and ore costs are not discounted by this configuration. Future events may have different rules.

sections.title: Resource collectors
sections.body: The November 2025 event also doubled Resource Collector production and capacity. That is described here for context only: Clashboard does not simulate collector output or resource capacity.

sections.title: When the event ends
sections.body: The event card disappears at the configured end time and displayed wall costs return to normal. Previously adjusted upgrade end times stay adjusted. If the app misses the entire event, it does not replay old boosts; import a fresh village export to correct stale timers. Widgets and notifications sync the event adjustments when the app opens.

sections.title: Try the remote content flow
sections.body: Open the News tab in the Welcome / What’s New sheet to read the announcement. Tap Hammer Jam below Selected Profile to open this page and see the ending countdown. Pull to refresh in News after the feed is published. Use a test village for timer checks, because this active test can shorten eligible tracked timers.

sections.title: Reference rules
sections.body: The historical event format used for this test comes from Supercell’s “HAMMER JAM Kickstarts the November Season!” announcement, published November 1, 2025: https://supercell.com/en/games/clashofclans/blog/news/hammer-jam-kickstarts-the-november-season/
